BWC
Description
iRules commands for working with bandwidth control.
Commands
BWC::color
- allows a category assignment to
dynamic policies
BWC::debug
- used for troubleshooting a bwc
policy instance
BWC::mark
- assign tos and qos values to a
flow
BWC::measure
- start or stop measurement
on a per policy or on a per flow basis
BWC::policy
- Attach/Detach a bandwidth
policy to a flow
BWC::pps
- allows modification of the packets
per second for the session
BWC::priority
- map a policy instance or
category to a priority class of a priority group
BWC::rate
- allows for a different bandwidth
be set on dynamic policies
